descriptions.manageTenants: Manage tenant records, base teams, and memberships
descriptions.userApiKeys: Manage per-user API keys. Each user can hold multiple keys for distinct integrations (e.g. Chat AI agents, automations), independent of the legacy single-key "API User" type.
descriptions.customFieldGroups: Define per-tenant field groups (panels like Address) for Contact, Lead, Account, Opportunity
descriptions.customFieldDefs: Define typed custom fields whose values are stored on each record without schema DDL
